art.title: The Milkmaid
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons (Google Art Project)
art.story: A kitchen maid in a white cap and a blue apron pours milk from a jug into a bowl, slowly, as if nothing else in the world mattered. Light from the window falls on the bare wall, the hanging basket and the crusts of bread on the table, which Vermeer dotted with tiny beads of paint so they seem to sparkle. Down on the floor sits a little foot stove, for warm feet on cold days. Vermeer made only about 35 paintings in his whole life, and many of them are this quiet.
